method: All completed hosted job logs, deduplicated by exact cache key. No previous-run size substitutions remain.

llvm_and_clang_only.scope: Apply the local LLVM saving fraction to all platform LLVM/Clang cache bytes; hold every other group constant.

uniform_saving_illustration.scope: Illustration only: apply the LLVM saving fraction uniformly to every cache group. Other groups were not benchmarked, so this is not a measured or validated forecast.

category_specific_illustration.scope: Illustration only: use local category-specific size ratios for LLVM/Clang, Rust, other tools, and build/dependency archives; hold downloads, GCC, Guix source and package managers constant. Linux samples do not establish cross-platform ratios.

limitations: A Linux x64 LLVM sample cannot establish compression savings for other operating systems, Rust toolchains, installed tools, dependency stores or compiled outputs.
No new full CI run at level 9 is selected. Actual repository inventory is limited by eviction and is not a measurement of the complete working set.
